content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-recruitment restriction exists anywhere in the agreement, which matches our preferred position.

input.quote: 10.2 No Joint Venture. The Parties agree that and acknowledge that the relationship of the Parties is in the nature of an independent contractor. This Agreement shall not be deemed to create a partnership or joint venture and neither Party is the other's agent, partner, employee or representative.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "personnel", "employ or engage" and "compete" across the full agreement return no restrictive covenant on hiring or soliciting either Party's employees. The only employment-related language is the independent-contractor/no-joint-venture provision (Section 10.2) and the indemnity reference to "HDI, its employees, or agents", neither of which restricts the Company from soliciting or hiring HDI personnel. The absence of any non-solicit or no-hire binding the Company meets the preferred position ("No non-solicit on Customer"), so no redline is warranted.
